titulo.alumno: Reading a message · Verbs, passive and order

intro: Part 1: reading a message. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: In an affirmative main clause the conjugated verb usually takes second position. In common subordinate clauses, «ikke» comes before the conjugated verb. The passive can be formed with «blive + participle» or with «-s».
